name: Lutherweg 1521 (Teilstück Friedberg - Neu Isenburg)
description_md:
The Lutherweg 1521 spans 51.1 km from Friedberg to Neu Isenburg in Germany. This waymarked hiking route is signed as LW1521 and belongs to the national waymarked hiking network.

Walkers face 454 m of ascent alongside 498 m of descent on this path. The journey requires about 14 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. This trail is categorized as hard due to the distance and ascent. Along the way, the route passes Frankfurt within 100 m, Deutsche Bank within 800 m, and Senckenberganlage within 1900 m.
